text:
Alyssa (CS): Heads up — Tranquility Health renewal coming up (renewal date 2026-05-10). Customer wants to change to a 9mo term (currently 12), add 15 seats, and pay via PO (net30) with vendor code. They also want to use their org DocuSign. Need: updated pricing, SOW amendment, and confirmation on e-sign path. Any blockers?
Marco (AE): OK noted. They asked for a concession to move to 9mo — I penciled a 10% concession on the prorated term. Need ops to confirm invoice flow for PO + vendor code.
Jenn (Product): Quick product check — 15 seats doesn't trigger Dedicated. No infra changes. Just FYI: if they increase usage we might suggest batching tweaks but not needed now.
Carol (Ops): For PO path we need: (1) vendor code, (2) billing entity exact name (legal entity must match PO), (3) Purchase Order PDF, and (4) email to send invoice to. Also confirm whether they require KMS/HSM.
Alyssa (CS): I have vendor code pending from customer — asked them to include billing@tranquil-health.org and legal name = "Tranquility Health Inc." Waiting on PO upload.
Legal (Liaison): Flag: customer requested to add a data-processing exception in the amendment that our standard legal team can accept, but we need the signatory authority on the PO to match the signatory on DocuSign or a legal attestation. If PO signer differs, we need an exec approval email from customer.
Marco (AE): I'll ask CFO to confirm signer and push for PO today. If they don't have a PO by EOD, we can accept card but they prefer PO.
Alyssa (CS): Pricing calc snapshot — posting so ops has numbers:
```
Base annual list: $120,000
Prorate for 9 months: 120000 * 9/12 = 90000
Apply 10% concession: 90000 * 0.9 = 81000
Seats add: 15 seats * $50/seat/month * 9 months = 6750
Total one-time/term amount = 81000 + 6750 = $87,750
Invoice schedule: single net30 invoice for $87,750
```
Carol (Ops): Thanks — ops will generate the amendment and invoice once PO + vendor code arrive. Note: billing system requires vendor code before generating a PO-level invoice. If PO delayed >3 business days, ops can provision on a trial SOW and bill later (ops escalation needed).
DocuSign Bot: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/ABC123 — waiting for Tranquility signer. (env created by Alyssa)
Alyssa (CS): Uploaded amendment draft to DocuSign and CC'd legal@redwood.com. I've asked customer to confirm signer name and upload PO.
Marco (AE): Customer replied — will upload PO by EOD and signer is CFO (matches DocuSign). I'll confirm when it's in.
Legal (Liaison): Good — if CFO signs on DocuSign and PO, legal is clear. We'll mark review done on receipt.
Alyssa (CS): Quick checklist: vendor code ✅ (waiting final number), PO upload ✅/pending, DocuSign envelope ✅, legal review ✅ once signer matches, ops invoice flow pending. I'll follow up in the morning if no PO.
Carol (Ops): Once PO lands, send to ops@redwood.com with subject: "Tranquility PO - 9mo Amendment" and we'll run invoice.
Marco (AE): I will ping CFO now. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
